points.why: It says history can't separate the models because two models can fit the same net curve with completely different internal flows, so fit doesn't validate mechanism.
It has someone who built neither model, such as a support or sales lead, defend each causal link, and flags parameters tuned only to improve fit.
It identifies divergent checkable predictions (gross adds vs churn paths, penetration, churn by support experience, segments) and says to write down refutation criteria beforehand.
It asks which uncertain parameter would flip the expansion-versus-support recommendation and says to measure those first.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly says not to choose on fit.
